paragraphs: QQQ is +2.69% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -13/100 (Mixed / Neutral). Score path: pre-market -46 → now -13; open +10 → now -13 (deteriorated 23 points).

The main live drivers are Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 4.936%, +0.4 bp since the opening snapshot. The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.710% (+7.5 bp vs prev close). Semiconductors are supportive: Previous regular-session close · SOX +4.69% | Nasdaq +2.31% | SOX vs Nasdaq +2.38 pp | SOXX vs Nasdaq +2.45 pp | SMH vs Nasdaq +1.86 pp.
The upside move is broadly confirmed by Nasdaq internals (semiconductors positive, mega-caps mixed, breadth positive).

What would change the view: improvement would require VXN/VIX cooling. Deterioration would be reinforced by a reversal in the 10Y back above roughly 5.00–5.05%, semiconductor leadership rolling over, breadth narrowing materially.
